_doc: Design-axis registry (SPEC_PET_DESIGN_AXES §1). One entry per axis, in MENU ORDER — the order /api/design-axes returns them and the design step renders them. Each entry names an axis file <key>.json in this directory; a registry entry without its file, or an axis file without its entry, fails the build (tests/test_design_axes.py — the half-formed-entry rule). Only ONE of the surface axes (coat/plumage/scales) ever shows for a given animal, chosen by its resolved surface, so listing all three here keeps menu order stable across animals. `max_concurrent_strong` is the §11.6 soft-cap on concurrently-selected strong (min_strength-declaring) modifiers — MEASURED null (Phase 3, 2026-07-16): the stack tests (colour + accessory + pattern + surface + expression, with and without body at 0.9) showed no destructive interference on any of the four matrix animals, so no cap is needed at the Tier 1 vocabulary size. Re-measure if Tier 2 axes land.
